# ImageTo20KB

> ImageTo20KB (https://www.imageto20kb.in/) is a free browser-based image compressor. Users choose a target size in KB (for example 20KB or 100KB); compression runs locally in the user's browser and images are not uploaded for compression.

## Tools
- [Compress Image to 20KB Online](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-image-to-20kb/)
- [Compress Image to 100KB Online](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-image-to-100kb/)
- [Compress JPG to 20KB](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-jpg-to-20kb/)
- [Compress JPG to 100KB](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-jpg-to-100kb/)
- [Compress PNG to 20KB](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-png-to-20kb/)
- [Compress Image to 50KB](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-image-to-50kb/)
- [Compress Image to 200KB](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-image-to-200kb/)
- [Compress Image to 500KB](https://www.imageto20kb.in/compress-image-to-500kb/)
- [Image Resizer Online](https://www.imageto20kb.in/image-resizer/)
- [Image Compressor Online](https://www.imageto20kb.in/image-compressor/)
- [Image Compressor for Online Forms](https://www.imageto20kb.in/image-compressor-for-online-forms/)

## Supported formats
- Input: JPG/JPEG, PNG, WebP. Output: JPEG, WebP or PNG depending on the browser.
- Not supported: animated GIF/WebP/APNG, SVG, HEIC/HEIF.
- 1 KB = 1,024 bytes. Targets are not always achievable; the tool reports when a result is above target.
